items.title: [Feature][MoE] Add exact expert offload for V2 eager and decode ACL graphs
items.author: xuanbozzz
items.excerpt: This PR adds exact MoE expert offload for single-device inference on Ascend 950PR/950DT (A5). It enables large MoE checkpoints, including DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 and GLM-5.3-Flash , to run when their full expert weights exceed NPU memory cap
